name: Hopea and other lowland trees
desc: Evergreen tropical wet forest on limestone below 800 m covers about three quarters of the park. Hopea is one of its listed trees, and the leaves and fruit of such trees feed primates and other forest animals.
about: Hopea is a genus of plants in the family Dipterocarpaceae. It contains some 114 species, distributed from Sri Lanka and southern India to the Andaman Islands, Myanmar, southern China, and southward…
